listing.name: Big Fighter Ship Pack 1.0.3
listing.summary: "Fighters were sick of only being deployed when attached to carriers, so they evolved into their own ships."
listing.aiSummary: Adds frigates upscaled from vanilla fighters, distributed among vanilla factions with adjusted power and DP costs.

description: Adds frigates upscaled from vanilla fighters, distributed among vanilla factions. The frigates' DP matches their originals' OP cost, and their power is adjusted accordingly. Each frigate carries a single wing of its respective fighter type.
